task: Write one sentence of your own using the word perfidious. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know perfidious should be able to work it out from your sentence.
avoid_verbatim: Every spy thriller needs its perfidious insider — the smiling colleague with a second phone.
Unreliable stops far short of perfidious — the unreliable friend forgets your birthday, not your trust.
Disloyal stops short of perfidious — disloyalty drifts away from you, while perfidy smiles at your table and sells your secrets.

Treacherous means betraying a trust — the guard who opens the gate to the enemy. Perfidious sharpens the charge: the perfidious traitor keeps performing loyalty the whole time, smiling at your table while working against you. Treachery names the betrayal itself; perfidious stresses the false show of faithfulness kept up meanwhile.

Traitorous is the word for betraying a country or public cause one is sworn to — it lives in politics and war. Perfidious is wider and more personal: any deep trust betrayed under a mask of continuing loyalty, by a friend, a manager, or an ally as easily as a soldier.
